context: Evaluates the implementation of a Pinia authentication store using the composition API style. The store must manage authentication and password-set state, expose an isAuthenticated computed property, and implement four async actions that integrate with external backend calls while correctly handling loading state, success, and error cases.

checklist.name: defineStore setup
checklist.description: The store is defined with defineStore using the composition API (setup function) style and given the name 'auth'.

checklist.name: State refs
checklist.description: status is typed as 'unauthenticated' | 'authenticated', passwordSet is a boolean ref, loading is a boolean ref, and error is a string | null ref, all initialized to their correct defaults.

checklist.name: isAuthenticated computed
checklist.description: isAuthenticated is a computed property that returns true when status.value === 'authenticated', not a direct ref.

checklist.name: init action
checklist.description: init() sets loading to true, calls the backend status-check function, sets passwordSet from the response, handles errors by storing a translated error string, and always resets loading to false in a finally block.

checklist.name: setPassword action
checklist.description: setPassword() calls the backend set-password function, sets passwordSet and status to 'authenticated' on success (returning true), stores a translated error message on failure (returning false), and manages loading state throughout.

checklist.name: verifyPassword action
checklist.description: verifyPassword() calls the backend verify function, sets status to 'authenticated' on success (returning true), stores a translated error on failure (returning false), and manages loading state.

checklist.name: logout action
checklist.description: logout() sets status back to 'unauthenticated' and clears error to null.
